limitations: Single-owner batch-approved inherited parser facts, not independent adjudication or a representative holdout.
Canonical field projection and original-source-to-text transforms are new engineering contracts and have not received a separate human review.
Exact claims cite retained derived text. HTML is DOM text, JSON uses fixed literal content fields, ICS retains literal compact dates; none is OCR or a production official-adapter benchmark.
Null/unknown facts are explicitly unscored pending canonical abstention labeling; no scheduled status, timezone, duration or date was invented for scoring.
Literal venue aliases can differ without establishing a factual error; those differences require semantic adjudication.
Source conflicts, program/resource mapping, visible ticket-link semantics and exhaustive entity sets remain review work.

Matching keys use original source units, actual predicted kind/action type and source-local ordinal. Missing opens cannot shift a detected deadline onto the wrong reference. Reconciliation of repeated detail/listing text is not extraction field scoring.

The preserved initial preparation-v1 report used global ordinal keys and could compare a deadline with an application-open reference. It is a scoring-association artifact; preparation-v2 fixed that association, and preparation-v3 also excludes start-derived precision when start time conflicts. Contract changes are not extraction-quality improvements.
No comparison to the synthetic diagnostic establishes quality improvement; no model/prompt comparison or holdout acceptance occurred.
